content.value_statement: Rust Lambda functions can waste cost through slow I/O, cold starts, and poor memory settings. This skill reviews handlers and deployment settings, then suggests concrete performance and cost improvements.
actual_capabilities: Identifies sequential async work that could use Tokio join patterns.
Reviews whether expensive clients are initialized once and reused.
Suggests Cargo release profile settings for smaller Lambda binaries.
Recommends ARM64 builds when price and performance fit the workload.
Explains memory sizing tradeoffs for CPU-bound and simple functions.
Highlights batch processing and early validation patterns for lower cost.
limitations: It provides review guidance and does not run benchmarks.
It cannot inspect AWS account metrics unless the user provides them.
It focuses on Rust Lambda functions, not every Lambda runtime.
It does not deploy or change infrastructure by itself.

use_cases.title: Review a New Handler
use_cases.description: Find performance risks before a Rust Lambda handler reaches production.

use_cases.title: Reduce Serverless Cost
use_cases.description: Identify memory, architecture, and batching changes that may lower Lambda spend.

use_cases.title: Improve Cold Starts
use_cases.description: Check binary size and resource initialization patterns that affect startup time.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Lambda Review
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a Rust Lambda handler and want quick feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Rust AWS Lambda handler for simple performance and cost improvements. Focus on async work, client creation, and memory settings.

prompt_templates.title: Cold Start Check
prompt_templates.scenario: You are preparing a function for production traffic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Rust Lambda project for cold start risks. Review Cargo release settings, binary size choices, resource initialization, and architecture options.

prompt_templates.title: Cost Optimization Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to reduce Lambda cost for an existing service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Lambda code and deployment configuration for cost optimization. Look for memory sizing, batching, early returns, ARM64 suitability, and avoidable latency.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Production Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a deeper review across code and deployment tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a production readiness audit for this Rust Lambda workload. Prioritize issues by expected impact, confidence, operational risk, and measurement steps.

output_examples.input: A handler creates an HTTP client on every invocation and then calls one external API.
output_examples.output: The review would flag repeated client creation, recommend reusing the client across warm invocations, and explain the expected latency benefit.

output_examples.input: A function awaits user, post, and comment lookups one after another.
output_examples.output: The review would identify independent I/O work and suggest running those awaits concurrently with an error-aware join pattern.

output_examples.input: A Cargo project lacks release profile size settings for Lambda deployment.
output_examples.output: The review would recommend size-focused release settings and explain how smaller artifacts can improve cold start behavior.

best_practices: Provide the handler, Cargo.toml, and deployment settings for the most useful review.
Validate recommendations with production-like load tests before changing memory or architecture.
Ask for impact estimates and measurement steps when comparing several optimizations.
anti_patterns: Do not apply concurrency suggestions when operations depend on each other.
Do not increase memory without measuring latency and total cost together.
Do not treat example deployment commands as automatic infrastructure changes.

faq.question: Does this skill run AWS commands?
faq.answer: No. It is configured for reading and searching files only.

faq.question: Which runtime does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Rust AWS Lambda functions and common Rust deployment settings.

faq.question: Can it reduce my Lambda bill automatically?
faq.answer: No. It suggests changes that you can test and apply in your own environment.

faq.question: Does it require CloudWatch metrics?
faq.answer: No, but metrics improve memory sizing and cost recommendations.

faq.question: Can it review Cargo Lambda projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for cargo-lambda builds, release profiles, and ARM64 choices.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-Rust Lambda code?
faq.answer: Some concepts apply broadly, but the examples and checks are written for Rust.
